propositions: A new NDJSON snapshot store must persist point-in-time metrics (coverage %, complexity, clone count) as an append-only, durable series under .rebar/ so trend history accumulates across CI runs.
The write_snapshot function appends timestamped records to .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson and read_snapshots yields records filtered by date range (since, until).
The snapshot file must be surgically un-ignored in .gitignore via !.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson so it is committed and synced, unlike the gitignored /reports/ directory.
Malformed or truncated NDJSON lines are skipped without raising an exception, allowing the reader to return only valid records.
Unit tests verify round-trip write/read, date range filtering, and resilience to corrupt lines, plus confirm the file path is not matched by .gitignore.
